atlases.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production wall-edge TILESET PNG for a top-down 16-bit pixel-art dungeon. Input image is reference ONLY for blue-black royal stone palette and texture, not an edit target. EXACTLY 4 columns by 2 rows of equal square tiles, no gaps, no labels, no objects, no background beyond the filled tiles. Each tile visually authored on a 16x16 coarse pixel grid, enlarged nearest-neighbor. Slate navy stone, restrained blue-gray highlights, dark grout, top-left light, authentic SNES pixel texture. These are the TOP SURFACE of thick stone dungeon walls, NOT front-facing tall walls and NOT pillars. Tile order row-major: 0 plain dark wall-top stone filling whole tile; 1 same stone with a crisp horizontal blue-gray stone coping cap along its TOP edge and a dark contact seam below it; 2 same stone with a narrow raised vertical rim along LEFT edge; 3 TOP plus LEFT edges meeting as coherent upper-left corner; 4 RIGHT edge rim (darker than left); 5 TOP plus RIGHT edges upper-right corner; 6 BOTH LEFT AND RIGHT edge rims, no top rim; 7 TOP LEFT RIGHT edges forming a closed narrow wall end. Rims approximately 3 original pixels thick. Tiles fill entire cells edge to edge, entirely opaque, square straight edges (not floating blocks), seamlessly tiling wall interiors. No transparent borders, no bevel on unspecified edges, no top-down floor decoration, no gold line. Preserve reference low-key blue dungeon tonality while making the top boundary legible.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite atlas, not an illustration. Authentic coarse-pixel 16-bit SNES fantasy dungeon VFX, sharply stepped clusters and deliberate bright opaque cores, limited jewel palette per row, NO antialiasing, blur, smooth gradients or painted textures. Genuinely TRANSPARENT background, no ground, no borders, no labels, no letters. EXACTLY SIX equal columns, each cell square. Every row is ONE effect animated left to right in six separate centered frames: 1 immediate opaque ignition, 2 rapid form expansion, 3 maximum energy, 4 edges fracturing, 5 isolated sharp fragments and a small dense core, 6 tiny remnants. The form grows and disintegrates IN PLACE; do not move the whole image sideways, do not fade the whole image opacity. Each cell centered on its own fixed center with at least 10% transparent margin; no overlapping cells. Final cells still visible. Native art should look designed on a 64x64 pixel grid per cell, enlarged with nearest neighbor. Make the animation exceptionally readable at 64px. EXACTLY FOUR equal rows (6 columns x 4 rows, landscape 3:2). Row1: a silver/ivory shockwave rosette with four ragged wings (burst). Row2: a forceful copper-orange HORIZONTAL lance of forward momentum, spear-shaped streak expanding around a stationary central spine (charge), no crescent. Row3: turquoise-green protective vortex woven from leaves of light, irregular ring with inward flecks (aura). Row4: deep cobalt and silver hexagonal aegis, faceted shield-like energy plate cracking into blue shards (shield). No literal hand-held equipment. All four rows visibly distinct silhouettes.
